newsitem.title: USA: Open Plan sees Q1 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Open Plan sees Q1 below expectations.

text.p: Open Plan Systems Inc said Wednesday it expected its first-quarter results to fall short of earlier expectations.

Still, President and Chief Executive Stan Fischer said in a statement that "sales and earnings growth should increase as the year continues, and we continue to look for suitable partners for continued product and geographic franchise expansion."

No reason was given for the lower-than-expected first quarter results. The original projection was not disclosed. The results from the first quarter of the previous year were not immediately available.
The first-quarter mean earnings estimate is $0.18 per share, according to First Call.
Open Plan, which manufactures and markets modular office work stations, did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further information.
